note: kg's setq and defun both write through Fe's single per-symbol value cell (fe.c: a symbol is (name . value)), so defun after setq clobbers the plain value: kg evaluates to ((lambda nil 9) 9) -- f now holds the closure object itself. Emacs keeps separate value and function cells (Lisp-2): (list ... f (f)) is (7 9) -- f's value (7) survives defun, which only changed its function cell.
